implementation_commit.message: fix(P10): harden probe join and receipt retry paths

review_scope.scope: Complete P10 Controller/Agent probe, receipt, activation, provider-result, and persistence diff was inspected against the P10 plan and frozen protocol/state contracts.
review_scope.bounded_fix_decision: The only additional proven defect found during this review was the Agent retry gate: ReceiptSent records a transport write, not the Controller semantic acknowledgement. Consumed receipts must therefore be retried after reconnect while the tombstone remains. No speculative Controller refactor was retained.
review_scope.reverted_experiment: A payload-derived envelope message-ID rejection was tested and reverted because the frozen transport contract specifies same-message-ID dedup/conflict semantics rather than requiring derivation, and existing probe-sink tests intentionally use arbitrary valid envelope IDs.
